sources.title: High Commission of Mauritius in Geneva: consular services
sources.publisher: High Commission of the Republic of Mauritius in Geneva
sources.officialityEvidence: This live consular page is hosted on the Government of Mauritius govmu.org domain. Its current numbered service entry is expressly headed ‘Visa Requirements for holders of Kosovo Passport’ and gives a pre-departure application time.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of a Kosovo Passport must apply for a visa at least one month prior to their departure for Mauritius

sources.title: Mauritius Passport and Immigration Office: Application for Visa
sources.publisher: Passport and Immigration Office, Republic of Mauritius
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Passport and Immigration Office page is hosted on Mauritius's govmu.org government domain and directly instructs visa applicants to receive the application outcome before travelling.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applicants should wait for the outcome of their application before undertaking any travel to Mauritius.

sources.title: Uruguay Ministry of the Interior: Admission visa regime
sources.officialityEvidence: Uruguay's Ministry of the Interior published this current schedule on 19 August 2025. It expressly makes the common-passport table exhaustive by requiring a prior consular visa for citizens of countries absent from it; Kosovo is absent.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los ciudadanos de los países que no figuran en la presente nómina están sujetos al requisito de previa visa consular en las distintas categorías.

sources.title: Uruguay Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Application for a visa to enter Uruguay
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official consular procedure tells nationalities subject to Uruguay's admission-visa regime to apply at least 30 business days before travel, directly establishing advance issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La solicitud de visa debe realizarse al menos con 30 días hábiles de antelación a la fecha del viaje.

policies.title: Kosovo ordinary passports: Mauritius advance visa
policies.summary: Mauritius's current government consular page expressly says Kosovo passport holders need a visa and must apply at least one month before departure.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Kosovo passport for a short visitor trip; diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien and other travel documents are outside this finding.
Apply for the visa at least one month before departure for Mauritius; this is an advance-visa baseline, not electronic or arrival issuance.
Final admission, passport validity, return travel, accommodation, funds, work, residence, transit and any individual immigration-officer conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Kosovo ordinary passports: Uruguay advance consular visa
policies.summary: Uruguay's current exhaustive common-passport schedule requires citizens of countries absent from the table, including Kosovo, to obtain a consular visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary Kosovo passport for a short visitor trip; diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien and other travel documents are outside this finding.
Uruguay's schedule expressly requires a prior consular visa for citizens of countries not present in its common-passport table, and Kosovo is not present.
Apply through a competent Uruguayan consulate before travel; the current consular procedure says applications must be made at least 30 business days before the trip.

unresolved.reason: No current Azerbaijani or Kosovo passport-authority source directly maps an ordinary Kosovo passport to a short-visitor route and actual issuance timing. Azerbaijan's listed eVisa and visa materials are not treated as a Kosovo-eligibility complement.

No current Belarusian or Kosovo passport-authority source directly identifies an ordinary Kosovo passport in a visitor visa, border or electronic-issuance rule. Recognition and omission are not used to infer a status.

Current Chilean consular material says Chile does not recognize Kosovo as a subject of international law, but does not directly state how an ordinary Kosovo-passport visitor document is processed. That non-recognition statement is not normalized as a visa status.

No current Gabonese or Kosovo passport-authority source directly maps ordinary Kosovo passports to a nationality-wide visitor route. Gabon's eVisa materials do not provide a direct Kosovo eligibility and issuance result.

Kazakhstan's current passport-type table and eVisa guidance do not directly identify Kosovo. A missing row cannot establish a visa-required, electronic or arrival route for an ordinary Kosovo passport.

No current Montserrat or Kosovo passport-authority source directly establishes the ordinary Kosovo-passport short-visitor route or its issuance timing. Immigration-law country omissions are not used as a complement.

Mexico's current official consular guidance says it does not recognize Kosovo passports and cannot issue a Mexican visa or migration privilege to their holders. The available taxonomy has no document-unrecognized or entry-impossible status, so this cannot be normalized as fallback visa_required.

No current Serbian or Kosovo authority source directly establishes a nationality-wide ordinary Kosovo-passport short-visitor route and issuance timing. Serbian treatment, recognition and route controls are not inferred into a visa-free baseline.

No current Uzbek or Kosovo passport-authority source directly maps an ordinary Kosovo passport to a short-visitor route or actual issuance timing. Absence from named eVisa or visa-waiver materials is not a complement.
